title: Inspector blob (INS)
description: data/inspect.json: what the design inspector reads. Per design: the binder as PDB text in the reference frame, contacts, hydrogen bonds, per-residue tracks, confidence, context blocks. Field meaning, units, producers and consumers are in docs/data_contract.md section 4. Older blobs validate once a profile is added.

target_pdb.description: PDB text of the reference chain (chain A, UniProt numbering, heavy atoms, reference frame) with HELIX and SHEET records. Sugars attached to glycan sites may follow as HETATM records.

target_seq.description: One-letter sequence, one letter per entry of target_resi.

designs.description: tag -> inspector record. For BindCraft projects the tag is the design id.

order.description: Tags in display order. Every entry is a key of designs. Legacy pages show one button per entry; the refactored inspector shows a searchable list when there are more than twelve.

names.description: Optional tag -> display label (featured designs of a dataset). Superseded by designs[tag].label.

hotspots.description: Pooled hotspots (same as the campaign target.hotspots).

glycan_atoms.description: NEW. Same as the campaign target.glycan_atoms; drawn as sticks when the Glycans toggle is on.

runs.description: NEW. Per-run target constructs, for the frame strip and for hiding the removed stretches of a design's own run. Same objects as campaign runs[] reduced to id, label, hotspots and target.

term.description: NEW. The run's terminus block (campaign runs[].term): the format, what BindCraft was asked to do about the ends and the tag sizes. The inspector never reads the campaign blob.

olig.description: Partner-subunit context drawn as CA traces: neigh maps a chain key to a flat xyz array; buried is residue -> buried area. One entry per other chain, e.g. chains B, C and D of a tetramer, or chain B of a dimer.

buried_all.description: NEW. The whole interface of the reference chain with the partner: residue -> buried area, also the residues outside the union construct (buried keeps only the part inside it). The frame strip of the inspector draws it.

rest.description: NEW. Rest-of-chain context drawn as CA traces: the stretches of the reference chain that the target lacks. traces: [{label, chain, ranges, ca}], ca flat xyz, one trace per contiguous stretch.

foot.description: Named footprints of known complexes (same as campaign target.foot).

partners.description: Known-complex partners drawn as CA traces in the target frame: name -> {chains, traces}. traces is one flat xyz array per chain.

frame.description: LEGACY. Frame strip data: {len, nat, name, acc, construct, segs, glyc, nat_ends}. Superseded by profile.frame; the viewer reads the profile first.

real.description: LEGACY flag of older blobs. Deprecated; replaced by profile.caps.

run.description: Same object as campaign run (legacy inspector blobs carry it).

modes.description: Same object as campaign modes (legacy inspector blobs carry it).

design.description: One inspected design. Per-residue arrays of the binder have one entry per residue (n). Arrays over the target have one entry per target_resi (or per t_resi when the design carries its own target).

label.description: NEW. Display name in the design list.

run.description: NEW. Run id; selects runs[].target for the strip and for the removed stretches.

prov.description: NEW. Same object as campaign design.prov.

source_note.description: Set on illustrative stand-ins (a nanobody, an scFv, a peptide).

pdb_b.description: PDB text of the binder: chain B, residues 1..n, heavy atoms, reference frame, HELIX and SHEET records first, B-factor = pLDDT (0..100).

target_pdb.description: Own target (nanobody and scFv stand-ins). null = use the blob's target_pdb.

plddt_res.description: Binder pLDDT per residue, 0..100, length n.

plddt_t.description: Target pLDDT per target residue, 0..100. null (or 0) where the design's own target lacks the residue.

rsa_res.description: Binder relative accessibility in the complex, per residue.

dsasa_res.description: Binder area buried per residue in A^2, length n.

ddg_res.description: Alanine-scan ddG per binder residue (kcal/mol). null when profile.caps.ddg_scan is false.

t_dsasa.description: Target area buried per target residue in A^2; 0 where absent.

contacts.description: Residue pairs within 4.5 A. t = target residue (UniProt), b = binder residue (1-based), d = closest heavy-atom distance in A, n = atom pairs.

k.description: D>A: target donates; A<D: target accepts.

buns.description: Buried unsatisfied polar atoms. side t = target, b = binder; resi is UniProt for t and 1-based for b.

patches.description: Exposed hydrophobic patches on the binder, largest first (at most 3). res are 1-based binder residues.

voids.description: Reserved: cavities at the interface (not rendered by the current pages). May be empty.

dsasa.description: Buried area in A^2 (same value as metrics.dsasa).

ssbonds.description: The binder's disulfides, pairs of 1-based residues: those the structure file records, or when it records none, those read from SG-SG geometry (see ssbond_basis). Each residue is in at most one pair.

ssbond_basis.description: How ssbonds is known. recorded: the file lists the disulfides (mmCIF _struct_conn, PDB SSBOND). inferred: the file records none (BindCraft 2 writes none), so the pairs are read from the model's SG-SG distances, at most 3.4 A (see disulfides). none: no record and no sulfur coordinates; no cysteine is judged.

disulfides.description: The pairs of ssbonds with their evidence. Absent in older bundles.

d.description: SG-SG distance in the model, A. null when a recorded pair has no sulfur coordinates.

band.description: recorded: listed in the file. close: inferred, at most 3.0 A. loose: inferred, 3.0 to 3.4 A, the band where a predicted model is least sure.

mem_margin.description: A. -metrics.mem_excess: positive = clear of the membrane plane by that much.

pae.description: Base64 of an uint8 matrix of size (pae_n[0] + pae_n[1])^2, row-major, value = PAE / 0.125 (so 31.75 A is the maximum). Rows and columns: binder residues first, then pae_tres target residues. null when profile.caps.has_pae is false.

pae_n.description: [binder residues, target residues] in the matrix.

pae_tres.description: Target residues in the matrix, in order. Absent = target_resi.

poses.description: One entry per predictor: binder transform relative to the design (R, t) plus scores. BindCraft-only data: one entry, AF2 (BindCraft), identity.

seeds.description: Pose of repeat seeds (R, t) for the seed overlay. Empty when profile.caps.has_seeds is false.

sibs.description: Sequences on the same backbone, the design itself included. diff = 1-based positions that differ from the family's first listed sequence.

metrics.description: The campaign metrics of this design (same keys and values as design.m) plus length, plus min_ipae and ipae_mean from the PAE matrix when the campaign record lacks them.

liab.description: Sequence liabilities (long key names, unlike the campaign record).

region.description: Antibody region of the position (CDR1, FR2, ...).

basis.description: Disulfide entries only (Unpaired cysteine, Disulfide geometry loose): whether the pairing came from the file's record or from the model's geometry.

center.description: Centre of the interface in the reference frame (used to pull the partners apart).

regions.description: Antibody region per residue (FR1, CDR1, ...). null for non-antibodies.

chain_of.description: Antibody chain per residue (H or L, or K for non-antibodies).

nH.description: scFv: residues in the VH domain.

term.description: NEW. Copy of the campaign design's term block (docs/termini.md): the inspector never reads the campaign blob. Absent for a design the exporter did not judge.

ctx.description: Removed-region context (rest of the chain, or a removed domain). nearest = closest binder atom to the removed region (A); pair = [binder residue (1-based), target residue]; covered = contacted residues the removed region buries, covered_all = all target residues it buries, as [residue, area in A^2]. removed is [first, last] (legacy) or a list of such ranges.

ref.description: Structure the removed region is placed from (a PDB id such as 1ABC).

cut.description: NEW. Cut-end context: cut_points of the design's run and the contacted residues within checks.cut_k of them.

octx.description: Partner-subunit context (olig). A flagged region adds fp_ov, epi_prec, epi_rec and stalk here.

olig_buried.description: Contacted residues buried at the partner interface.

stalk.description: Contacted residues in the flagged region.

rms_head.description: A. Placement RMSD of the rigid part of the target on the reference.

real.description: LEGACY: dataset facts of the design. name, method, author, cls, outcome, label, esm_plddt, expressed, fam. Superseded by design.prov and the outcome object.

nbrs.description: Nearest designs by shared contacted residues (the Similar tab).
